grammar.title: Asking duration with 多久
grammar.explanation: 多久 (duōjiǔ) asks "how long" a duration lasts it usually comes right after the verb or at the end of the question.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ zài zhèr zhù le duōjiǔ?
sentences.en: How long have you lived here?
How long does this movie take?

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ xué Hànyǔ xué le duōjiǔ?
sentences.en: How long have you been studying Chinese?

sentences.pinyin: Cóng zhèr dào xuéxiào yào duōjiǔ?
sentences.en: How long does it take from here to school?
